quest.title: Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!
quest.description: Someone in Mondstadt's alchemy store seems to be talking about a strange package they received recently. Go check it out.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Beginner Player Badge x1, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

chapter.title: Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: So, Sucrose, the package you mentioned that you received before... It's not dangerous, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You need to be careful when you're opening packages. I once had a friend mail me some research materials, and all the bouncing around in transit caused a reaction...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Once I opened it, it let out a stench that could wake the dead.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: If your package contains anything like that, then maybe you should check with Albedo first and see what he thinks.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, this package didn't contain any hazardous materials...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Timaeus, Sucrose! What are you two chatting about?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Oh, hey you two! We're just talking about a strange package that Sucrose received recently.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A strange package?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Yes. I believe it's from a Sumeru scholar who came here to study in Mondstadt. It's most likely a thank-you gift for collaborating on some research together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, a package from an Akademiya scholar? Then there could be anything inside.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, it is a thank-you gift.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: There wasn't anything dangerous inside, just a bunch of strange cards.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I think I've seen Timaeus with some similar-looking cards before, so I came to ask him about what they might be.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You've seen me with some cards? Ah, maybe those were the testing cards used for distinguishing reagents?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, they didn't look like test cards. Here, have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Oh, you meant these... Huh, Sucrose, have you really never seen these before?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, never. Recently, I've been spending all my time up in the mountains working on cultivating Pentatanic Sweet Flowers. Why, is this an area of research that has started trending in the alchemical community during my absence?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Haha, you could definitely say that it's trending, but not as an area of research... It's a card game that's been getting really popular these days.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It's called "Genius Invokation TCG"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation TCG!

choices.text: So this is the game we've been hearing about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we've been hearing about this game all over the place, but this is the first time we've ever actually seen any of the cards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We didn't know it had made it all the way to Mondstadt. Must be pretty popular, huh?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: That's right. The game's been catching on lately. The Yae Publishing House in Inazuma has even published a series of light novels based on the game. The story is really good!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: It starts with a young guy in Sumeru who finds an ancient "Casket of Tomes" in the attic. He opens it, and discovers that the soul of an ancient TCG player called the Crocodile King has been captured inside.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: It turns out that the Crocodile King was King Deshret's viceroy, who battled an opponent named the Ibis King. During the match, the Crocodile King fell prey to his opponent's scheme and was sealed away in the Casket of Tomes.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: After being unexpectedly released by the kid, the Crocodile King possesses him and helps him to gradually climb the ranks and become a legendary TCG player.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Uh, Timaeus?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Huh? What's wrong, Sucrose? Uh, if you're interested in how the story plays out, I can lend you the novels.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No, I was just thinking about that time you requested an extension on your progress report deadline, citing "personal reasons" for the delay...

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Ahem, well... I did go through a phase recently where I wasn't putting enough focus on my work, but it's under control now. I've committed to not even touch Genius Invokation TCG until I've made enough progress in my research.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Aw, well that's unfortunate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? Why's that?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, since it's a gift from a researcher I've collaborated with, I thought that I should at least try to learn the rules. That way, I could say that I at least tried to appreciate his gift.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right... And since it's a game from Sumeru, who knows, playing it might even make you smarter!

choices.text: If you want to play, then just say it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, fine! Paimon's curious and would like to give it a try! ...Please?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Although it seems like we can't learn how to play it anytime soon 'cause Timaeus has given up for a while.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Haha, well research is my priority, you know.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: But if you'd like to learn the rules of Genius Invokation TCG, then I'd actually suggest you go to The Cat's Tail.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Yep, that's the place. It's where everyone in the community goes to play when they have time. They gather there, trade cards... and they're very welcoming to new players.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Trying to learn the rules can be intimidating at first, but it's a lot of fun once you get the hang of it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #Understood. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's go to The Cat's Tail and try asking around.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: To be honest, hearing Timaeus talking about the game has also piqued my curiosity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's get going!

choices.text: Then you desperately need to play this game.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, just wait until Paimon plays it enough to become smarter than you. Then you'll be sorry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Genius Invokation TCG! Haven't you heard of it before?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Apparently it's a game that was invented by a scholar in the Akademiya. People from all over are playing it now!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: #Welcome to The Cat's Tail. Ah, it's {NICKNAME} and Paimon, what a nice surprise!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Oh, and Sucrose the alchemist. It's been a while, hasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Heh...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I've already told you before: Fur from The Cat's Tail staff is not for sale, no matter how much Mora you offer.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ah, don't worry, Margaret, we're not here for that research project I told you about last time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Sucrose... what kind of experiment were you trying to do at The Cat's Tail?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh, I just wanted to test out some hypotheses, and I needed some materials... But, uh, we can talk about that later.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Actually, Margaret, we're here to learn more about Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Sucrose explains everything to Margaret...

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Ah, Genius Invokation TCG... We were just talking about that game.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: You see, more and more people have been gathering at The Cat's Tail to play, so I thought: Why not have a dedicated staff to serve the new customers?

choices.text: Fur? From The Cat's Tail staff?

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Ah, allow me to interpret. Ahem, Prince says that the word "customer" is much too loose of a term, and we should instead refer to anyone who loves dueling with cards as "TCG players."

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Hmm... my mistake. So it seems I haven't introduced you yet... This is Prince and Shuyun. They will be in charge of taking care of our "TCG players."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm afraid I must correct you there, Ma'am. Only Prince, the strongest and most formidable TCG player of all, is capable of providing valuable guidance to our new players.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: The average player is incapable of grasping the subtlety and sheer genius behind Prince's every play, and he has no choice but to rely on me to communicate with everyone. I am merely Prince's lowly assistant, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, another guy who can understand animals!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: How can you use such a crude word as "animal" to describe the one and only Prince? He is special and the only one of his kind... Such a remark is an insult to Prince!

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Oh? What's that? "Shuyun, in the eyes of the common folk, I look no different than any other ordinary cat. It's a natural mistake to make, and you shouldn't overreact." Ah, understood... I do apologize.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hmm, it seems he really is capable of communicating with the cat. Could this be the result of some modification to the language center of his brain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously, how can he get all of that from a simple meow?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Yes, it was the sacred duels of Genius Invokation TCG that formed and cemented our bonds of mutual understanding. It's my firm belief that by simply playing the game, players can develop a deeper level of understanding between one another.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: So playing Genius Invokation TCG fosters some sort of a telepathic link between players?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Somehow, Paimon doubts that.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Uh-huh... Anyway, if you'd like to know anything about Genius Invokation TCG, then please ask Shuyun... Uh, who will ask Prince.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Though I'd love to explain more myself, it's time for my daily walk. I'll let Prince play a game with you and walk you through all the rules.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Meow... "Just as a seasoned warrior can foresee the path of his opponent's sword, so too can I, as a TCG master, predict my opponent's every play. It would be improper to pit a newcomer to the art of the card against one such as myself, and I must therefore politely decline."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Ahem, that's what Prince said.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, PRINCE doesn't wanna play with us, huh? Fine, then Prince doesn't have to. We'll play you instead!

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: I'm sorry, but from the day I met the mighty cardmaster Prince, I swore an oath that my hands would live solely to hold the cards, and not to play them. I will never play another match of my own again.

choices.text: Right, Prince's paws probably can't hold the cards...

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: If Prince is unwilling to play, then I guess we should look for an alternative. How about this... Diona!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Yeah, blah blah blah, what is it? I'm pretty busy over here, you know!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hmph, why is it that every player that sets foot in here to play Genius Invokation TCG has to have a drink... Ugh! Don't they have any clue that the key to playing a game is the ability to think straight?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Seriously, games and drinks don't mix. Don't they get that? Ugh!

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: What can I say... As the tavern owner, I can't help but feel happy to hear this.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Anyway, I see you've been working hard so I thought you could use a break... So why not come over here and teach these customers the rules of Genius Invokation?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ha, hahah! Yeah! What kind of break is that? I'd rather not, hmph!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Oh... why are we letting all these loafers come in here to play Genius Invokation TCG anyway? All it does is encourage more people to come to the bar for a drink...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: *sigh* Ya know, if drinks sales keep going up like this, pretty soon, Mondstadt's alcohol industry is gonna reach new heights...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Grr, looks like my first step in destroying Mondstadt's alcohol industry should be stamping out the spread of Genius Invokation TCG!

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Meow... "My dear, you are quite mistaken. You said it yourself — a clear mind is necessary to win. Soon, their thirst for victory will overcome their thirst for alcohol..."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Prince speaks the truth, Diona. Not only is the spread of Genius Invokation TCG no obstacle to your goal of destroying Mondstadt's alcohol industry, it could even support you in this endeavor!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: C—Could it really?

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Sure, why not. Alrighty then, our two customers are waiting to learn... Shuyun, let's put you on drink-mixing duty for now.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Meow... "But Shuyun is destined for a far greater purpose..."

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Shuyun. Drink-mixing. Now.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: O—Okay...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ooo... alright! We'll need some space to learn, heheh. Let's go to that empty table over there.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: It was the duels of Genius Invokation TCG that allowed our hearts to bond. It's understandable that ordinary people such as yourselves are unable to comprehend such a thing.

talks.objective: Go to the empty table to learn the rules from Diona

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Ugh, let me guess — you're here to order a drink, hmph... Oh, it's you. So, how are your Genius Invokation matches going?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: You need to win three matches to become an official TCG player? Ohh yeah, now you mention it, I remember there being some sort of rule about that. Why'd they have to make it so competitive? It's just a game, why can't people just have fun!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'll never understand why grown-ups have to put a bunch of stupid rules on everything.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Diona's waiting for you. Go talk to her and she'll teach you the rules of the game."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: That's what Prince said. *sigh* And I need to go start mixing drinks. It's a pity that I can't look on while you learn...

talks.objective: Have a Genius Invokation TCG duel with Sucrose

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hehe, okay! Let's go through the rules. First things first, you'll be needing your deck, so place that on the table...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: A... deck?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Uh, yes? You should have built a deck. You know, a set of cards that meets the bare minimum requirement to play the game...?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Huh-huh... what's with the blank stares? ...C'mon, don't tell me you came to learn Genius Invokation TCG without bringing any cards?

choices.text: Actually, we do have some cards...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: That's right, we have some cards that I received from a friend.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Uhh... you're gonna need a few more cards than that.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Okay, lemme think... To learn the game, you'll need at least two Character Cards to switch between...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Oh, oh! That reminds me, a few days ago when I was closing up for the night, I noticed a customer had left a couple of Character Cards on the bar counter. Haha! Maybe you could use those for now.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Are you sure that's okay...?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Eh, it's already been a few days and he still hasn't come back to claim them. Who knows, maybe he left them here on purpose...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Oh. Okay, yeah. Got them here with me, you know, just in case the customer came looking for them. Yeah, yeah, not because I like to play the game or anything. Please...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, so now we have two Character Cards. That's everything we need, right?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Yup. So, are you ready to start?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Alright, then let's begin!

choices.text: Not just yet, I need a moment...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Okay, I guess I'll get things set up on the table first. Once you're ready, we can get started.

choices.text: Don't you have a practice deck we could try?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we need a practice deck! Can't you just let us use one?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Tch, there's no such thing!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Go, claim your Casket of Tomes, seize victory, and become a TCG champion!"

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Prince seems to have high hopes for you.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I can't believe I lost when we had the exact same Character Cards... The rules must be more complicated than I first thought.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Every decision is a difficult trade-off in this game. If there was only a way to transplant the arms of the two standby characters onto the active character's body—

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: That's not how the rules work, Sucrose. Don't be a sore loser. That kind of thing is looked down on in TCG circles.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh, I am sorry... I was beaten fair and square, I know that. I just can't stand losing.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: But it was a fun match.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't know you could get so competitive, Sucrose.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I always get a little upset when I lose.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: It's like that with my research, too. It always gets to me when my experiments don't go as planned, especially when there's an alchemy genius like Albedo around to compare myself to...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...Uhh, you lost me at "alchemy" and "experiments." But I'm pretty sure it's normal to feel that way.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Playing cards is no different. Each game you lose makes you wanna win the next one to settle the score, and the desire to win pushes you to improve your strategy and build a better deck.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hehe! Seizing victory through a winning combination of luck, skill, and experience is where all the fun of Genius Invokation lies!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: ...But what if you keep trying and trying, and never win a single game?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: A losing streak... Yeah, that'll definitely get you down. But it's way better to keep trying until you win than to just accept you're a plain old loser and give up!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hmm... you make a good point, Diona.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Besides, Sucrose, you're already making great progress. It'd take at least eight of our regular boozehounds to match your level. You played well this last match!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Agreed. It was a brilliant game.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Thank you... I'm just a little disappointed to lose, that's all. But Genius Invokation TCG is a really fun game.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Good. Having fun is the main thing. If you ever wanna play again in the future, feel free to come by The Cat's Tail... Ah, but don't expect me to play with you, I just mean this place probably has the right atmosphere...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'll definitely be back.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Alright, I think you should have the basics down by now. I need to get back to bartending — Shuyun's likely been busy making this tavern more popular with his delicious cocktails... Phooey, phooey, phooey! And we can't have that.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hmph! Burning Mondstadt's wine industry to the ground keeps me pretty busy, y'know! So if you need any more help, go bother Shuyun!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: I see, so you have now grasped the rules of Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehehe, that's right! {NICKNAME}, Sucrose, and Paimon are TCG players now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't notice you play any matches, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon picked it up from watching you and Sucrose!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Becoming a TCG player is not as simple as that. You cannot call yourselves true TCG players until you have passed the test."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Sobering words from Prince there... But I'm afraid he's right. To become official players recognized by the Genius Invokation TCG Society, you have to pass the test.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Yes, although to be honest, it's not that difficult...

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Basically, to become an official and recognized TCG player, you have to best three opponents in a duel.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: So you have to win three duels against three different opponents?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Meow... "The duel you just played can count towards this tally..."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: I agree. Although I didn't get to observe the match myself, I did listen along. And from what I could hear, you both performed at a rather high level.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Same way you can "hear" what Prince says...?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: #A well-trained ear is a basic skill expected of anyone hoping to become a TCG master. But back to the matter at hand — {NICKNAME} only needs to beat two more opponents to become an official TCG player.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Sucrose, you may have lost the last duel, but don't be disheartened. I can assure you that winning three games is well within your ability.

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Meow... "But first things first, Shuyun. Before that, our TCG newcomers should receive their free gift..."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Ah yes, my goodness. Completely slipped my mind — I'm lucky to have Prince here to remind me. Everyone who wants to start playing Genius Invokation TCG is entitled to claim a free Casket of Tomes.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh, Timaeus mentioned it, didn't he? It was from the light novels he's been reading. The thing that the main character found in his attic...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, that's right. The soul of an ancient TCG player was trapped inside, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the Casket of Tomes is actually real?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Heh, well... actually, all card cases in Genius Invokation TCG are called Caskets of Tomes. Not only do they provide a reliable and sturdy container to store your decks, they can also sense when other people in the area are also carrying a Casket of Tomes with them—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon can guess what you're gonna say next — the reason they can sense each other is because they have the souls of ancient TCG players inside!

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: That would mean an extraordinarily high number of people in history have been turned into disembodied souls as a consequence of playing card games... No, the real reason that it can sense other Caskets is because it holds a nifty little mechanism invented by Sumeru scholars...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Darn, what a letdown...

choices.text: Sounds like a convenient way of finding other TCG players.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, now let's see this Casket of Tomes already!

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: "Meow! All Caskets of Tomes are issued by Margaret, so you will need to see her to claim yours..."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Probably for the best. If Prince and I were responsible for handing them out, knowing how eager we both are to promote the game, we'd probably have dished them all out by now...

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Okay, so go and see Margaret to claim your Casket of Tomes, use it to find another player, beat them in a duel, and then come back here.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #But even for {NICKNAME}, that's only two wins in total. What about the last one?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: #Meow... "I shall choose the final contestant {F#she}{M#he} must beat in order to become an official TCG player, for it must be one of comparable prowess."

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: Excellent plan, Prince! Happy dueling, both of you.

choices.text: Where have I heard that before?
What does it entail? Sealing a Samachurl within a deck of cards?

response.speaker: Shuyun
response.text: It's just a tabletop card game. I'm not sure how you would plan on achieving something like that...

talks.objective: Go to Margaret and Claim the Casket of Tomes

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Hello you three, has Little Diona finished teaching you the rules of Genius Invokation?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Ah, I see, you're here for your Casket of Tomes, aren't you? A very useful tool indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: So this is a Casket of Tomes.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: That's right. A purpose-built case for your card deck, that can even detect when someone else nearby is carrying one... Gosh, whoever invented this must have seriously disliked being alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Well, even the most fun game is pretty lonely if you've got no one else to play it with.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: True. So I'm glad that these customers... ahem, TCG players are able to congregate at The Cat's Tail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't be bad for business...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: You're not wrong, but that's secondary. The important thing to me is the opportunity for like-minded people to come together and enjoy their favorite hobby. It creates a nice atmosphere... Anyway, now you have your Caskets of Tomes, it's time to find some opponents.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Alright. In that case, I'll go find some people to play against, too. Let's meet back at The Cat's Tail in a while!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Trust in your cards.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Thanks. I'll do my best.

talks.objective: Find a player and have a duel

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "You have not yet attained the status of official TCG players. First master the rules and hone your skills. Then, and only then, may you come and challenge me."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Yes, heed Prince's words. Besides, I need to keep mixing drinks for now. If you wait until I'm free, I can have Prince explain more for you...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Ready for our duel, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Let's play some Genius Invokation TCG!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, let the duel begin!

choices.text: Not just yet, I need a moment...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Sure. Even though it's just a game, it's important to be fully prepared. In that case, I think I'll go over the card stats again...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Gosh, I lost. You're remarkably good at this considering how new to the game you are.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Let's play again when you have some time. But... ideally not when I'm on duty...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: #Meow... "I sensed that {NICKNAME} had what it took to become an official TCG player, but {F#she}{M#he} has returned to the tavern more quickly than I had expected."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Defeat the opponent I have arranged for you, and you shall become an official TCG player. I look forward to watching this game immensely."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Not just Prince. I can't wait either. Come, your opponent is waiting for you in one of the private rooms.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{F#She}{M#He} won't lose to them, whoever it is! Right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Naturally.

What ho, fellow voyager of the stellar void. Yes, even I was briefly discountenanced when I heard the tidings of your sworn oath to become the Thrice Victorious... But so be it! You who are enslaved by dueling desire, be released from your shackles into the glorious arena of gladiatorial combat!
Step forth, O brave challenger, your Prinzessin grants you an audience. Hmph, hearken well! The wretched clock chimes yet again, as the declining light of the day grows dimmer still...
Pardon my directness, but we have not been waiting that long. Mein Fräulein could afford to be a little less impatient.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon knows those voices...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Your opponent sounds anxious to begin. Do not delay!"

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: That's what Prince said... Please enter, and enjoy your Genius Invokation TCG duel!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hehehe, let's see how you and Sucrose get along in your duel.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Now, I trained you myself, so you'd better not go down without a fight, okay! Huh, what? ...Well, yeah, I suppose I did train Sucrose, too... Hmm...

talks.objective: Have a Genius Invokation TCG duel with Fischl

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, is there anything I can assist the two of you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We wanna become official Genius Invokation TCG players, but we have to pass the test first, so we need to beat three other players in a duel. Our Casket of Tomes led us to you!

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Oh I see. Unfortunately, I'm on duty right now...

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: ...I see you're serious about this. Very well. As a fellow TCG player, I cannot refuse an earnest invitation to duel.

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: So be it. Then let the duel begin.

choices.text: "When it comes to your attention that a citizen of Mondstadt is in need, you must come to their aid promptly and willingly..."

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: Are you... quoting the Knights of Favonius Handbook at me...?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Impossible... Ugh, the cursed dragon looms near once more, casting its dark shadow on the slender threads of fate, hiding them from my vision...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Traveler... Was even this part of your plan?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What a truly ingenious plot, and what an exciting duel to witness.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Congratulations! You've won three duels now. That makes you an official TCG player!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! ...Oh, Sucrose, you're back. Does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Yep, I've won two games so far. When I got back, I heard you were in the middle of your final duel, so I came over to watch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice, Sucrose won two as well. Great work!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hmph. It seems I am forced to admit, fellow voyager of the stellar void, that your... mastery of the cards is second to none.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: To commemorate your glorious ascent to a battlefield beyond this lowly mortal realm, I grant thee an incarnation of my majesty in miniature. As you embark on this ingenious vocation, may you wield it in battle against all your fated foes, that not a single one of them may be left standing.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein wishes to give you a Mein Fräulein Character Card.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's Fischl's Character Card!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I dare not take advantage of the Prinzessin's generosity...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: 'Tis a mere token of such. To the victor of this splendid duel is a boon of commensurate splendor due.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh, um, excuse me Ma'am, I am also a beginner who has won two games so far. Might I also have the honor of joining you in a duel? If you would be willing, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Nothing would delight me more. I hereby grant you permission to join me in performing the hallowed rite of Genius Invokation.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: One other thing. When I got back, Prince and Shuyun said there was something they needed to give you if you managed to become an official TCG player.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Probably not... Oh, Paimon bets it's some kind of prize for making it as an official TCG player!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go get our prize!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No card game in the world has a card like that. Paimon bets it's some kind of prize for making it as an official TCG player!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Ah, so it WAS you who won the duel in the end. I knew you'd do it! Congratulations, you are now officially recognized members of the Genius Invokation TCG community!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "Very well done. Now, I will explain to you what becoming an official TCG player entails."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "The first thing all new official TCG players receive is their TCG Player's Handbook."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: This handbook tells you exactly what you need to do to become a top-tier TCG player. Make sure you read it.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Secondly, a range of Genius Invokation merchandise is now available to you for purchase here at The Cat's Tail. Hehe, so you see, becoming an official TCG player is really just the first step.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Meow... "And thirdly, whenever you wish to play a game with a friend, you can use the Invitation Board there. Whoever you wish to duel against, simply invite them to the tavern for a game."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Invitation Board?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Yes, it's right by the bar counter. Once you get the hang of it, you can play with your friends whenever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: That's it, really. If there's anything you didn't quite understand, you can always come and ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: Yes indeed, I'm quite sure they will. ...Oh, sorry, I forgot to translate for you. Prince would like to say:

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: #"{NICKNAME}, hope you'll have fun playing Genius Invokation TCG!"

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: If you're ready, let's not drag this out. I'm supposed to be standing guard...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I believe you've already met...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Met who?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: You know, Prince. This is The Cat's Tail, after all, so I thought having a cat take care of our new customers would be quite a nice touch.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Everything's set up. Let's learn how to play Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Alright, let's get started.

choices.text: Not just yet, I need a moment...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Sure, just let me know once you're ready. Hmph, but don't keep me waiting too long!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Great, let's continue learning how to play Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Alright, let's get started.

choices.text: Not just yet, I need a moment...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Sure, just let me know once you're ready. Hmph, but don't keep me waiting too long!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: We should start learning how to play Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Alright, cool, those are the basics. Did you get all that?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: What we just played was an Adventure Challenge, designed specially for new players.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation TCG can be played in duel mode, where each player brings three Character Cards, or in Adventure Challenge mode, with a fixed deck for each challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: But the rules are all the same. As long as you understand the basics, then you should be able to take on any of those rowdy boozehounds!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Although I feel there are still many details to grasp, I think I understand the basic premise of the game now.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: That was quite the detailed explanation. I didn't know The Cat's Tail's famous mixologist had such an eclectic skillset.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Waah! Wha— Oh! When did YOU get here...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I stepped in while you were in the middle of your explanation... I hope I didn't dampen the mood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You snuck in without making a sound...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ugh, anyway, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: The Cat's Tail is a player in Mondstadt's alcohol industry. Naturally, you have some collaboration with my winery.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I'm here today to discuss a few items of business with Margaret...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Too bad, she just left. But if you head off right now, you might still catch up with her!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Never mind, it's nothing urgent. In fact, I think I'm now more interested in this card that you're using to teach them the game.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Wait, this card...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's Diluc's Character Card.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Although I have some degree of experience with Genius Invokation TCG, seeing this particular card is a first for me...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Uh, a customer left it behind a few days ago. But he wasn't even playing the game while he was here.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Oh? And what sort of a customer was he?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Uh... He wasn't wearing an eyepatch, okay? He had a light complexion, and a super serious look on his face. He wasn't much of a talker, and looked like he was just drinking his worries away. Eh... never seen him around here before!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Eyepatch, you say...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Gah, I was trying to give the opposite description, but I just ended up giving it away. Sorry, Guard Captain...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Don't worry. Somehow, I don't think he'll be giving you any trouble over it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... what about the Diluc Character Card...?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I don't mind. It's just a card with my image on it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I didn't expect Diluc to be familiar with Genius Invokation TCG!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: The game has been catching on lately, it's hard to go anywhere without hearing it mentioned. Every now and then, I'll sit down and play a game with the customers in Angel's Share.

choices.text: You up for a game now?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I was hoping we could play a game... But this issue of someone leaving a Character Card with my image at The Cat's Tail is... very intriguing.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: It's getting late, and someone has some explaining to do... We'll have to have that duel another time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, I look forward to it!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Good. Then I'll take my leave.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: You know where the door is! Don't let the door hit ya where Lord Barbatos split ya!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Uh-oh... Guard Captain...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I hope Kaeya will be alright...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, now that we are familiar with the rules, why don't we try playing a game of Genius Invokation TCG?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ooh, two new players having their first ever duel... haha! This sounds like fun!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But, in order to play an official duel, you need to have three Character Cards.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Remember, a complete deck has to have three Character Cards and thirty Action Cards. Got it?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Then let's use my cards... These were mixed in with all the others I had received, and I didn't know what they were for at first. But now that we've learned the rules, I can see that this one must be the Sucrose Character Card.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Now, it looks like we each have the Kaeya, Diluc, and Sucrose Character Cards. So why don't we have our first duel?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, let's duel!

choices.text: ...Hold on, I need a moment. I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Take your time, I look forward to our first duel.

choices.text: I challenge you to a duel!
Waah! Wha— Oh! When did YOU get here...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: You have slow reactions... Wait— are you copying me!? Shut up!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I have to make drinks for the customers now...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: If you've got any more questions about Genius Invokation TCG, you can go ask Shuyun. He's over there.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Haha, see, don't underestimate me. I'm an official TCG player after all. My challenges are by no means easy.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Well? Fancy giving it another try?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it, it's Fischl and Oz!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Who else but the Prinzessin? For as the name of this hallowed rite suggests, only when the wisest of heroes is summoned can the master of cards hope to be crowned the champion.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: This path is a treacherous one... It must be tread with great caution, for eternal doom and damnation are but one wrong step away at any given moment.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: That is why none is more suited to appear in this audience chamber than the Prinzessin, whose Auge der Verurteilung des Großen Kaleidophantasmas has witnessed ten thousand battles across three thousand worlds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, is that right...

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Indeed, mein Fräulein has watched many games of Genius Invokation TCG, and has gained a solid grasp of the rules. Even in a duel between beginners, it is best that both participants are well-versed in them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's true.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, this makes sense now. Prince did say that he was gonna pair us with someone of a similar skill level... Guess that means Fischl hasn't been playing that long either!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmph, the Prinzessin needed but a single glance at these mere machinations of mankind to discern their working principles. Thus, with speed and brilliance paralleled by lightning alone do I now arrive here at the gateway to yonder circle of secrets...

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein, too, has bested two opponents thus far, and is therefore one step away from becoming an official TCG player.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So there's a lot on the line, huh? Either Fischl or {NICKNAME} is gonna come out of this duel as an official TCG player...

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Indeed.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmph! The Prinzessin herself heeds the call of fate and descends to this realm from the Immernachtreich, yet still you dare to doubt the inevitability of the inevitable. Your stubborn foolishness is contemptible.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein, I implore you to consider less odious turns of phrase, lest you be forced to feast on your words in the fullness of time.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Wh— ...I shall not lose, Oz!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: What say you, outlander? Do you wish to make an enemy of me, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, who even now begins to strum the strings of fate that shall sound out the Traveler's Requiem?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Then I say it is time to see what you are made of!

choices.text: Wait, wait, wait, I need to check my deck first...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Oh, do you? How disappointing. But then again, for one accustomed to the petty burdens of this lowly realm, to challenge the Prinzessin is a load under which most mere mortals would crumble.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I ask you once again, outlander: Do you wish to make an enemy of me?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Then it is time to see what you are made of!

choices.text: Not yet... I entreat Your Majesty to ask me again later...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Very well, I will ask you again when the time comes. But be warned, should you seek to flee when the hour of the battle draws nigh... I shall show you no mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: It seems that you fall short of the superior skills of the Prinzessin. But I know you, Traveler, and even this shall not stop you from facing me again!

choices.text: I will face you again right here, right now!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Then show me once more what you are made of!

choices.text: Yes! ...But I need a moment to rethink my strategy first.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Very well. When you think you are ready, I shall be right here waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: #Meow... "{NICKNAME} shows greater skill than most beginners, but Fischl displays greater prowess still..."

dialogues.speaker: Shuyun
dialogues.text: #Oh, you really think so? I think {NICKNAME} has the edge, personally...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Hold on, I need a moment. I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: So, Sucrose, the package you mentioned that you received before... It's not dangerous, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You need to be careful when you're opening packages. I once had a friend mail me some research materials, and all the bouncing around in transit caused a reaction...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Once I opened it, it let out a stench that could wake the dead.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: If your package contains anything like that, then maybe you should check with Albedo first and see what he thinks.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: No, this package didn't contain any hazardous materials...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Timaeus! What are you chatting about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And... who might this be?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Oh, hello you two. This is Sucrose.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Sucrose, Albedo's assistant. If you have any alchemy-related queries, you could always ask me. I'd... do my best to help...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't have to be so nervous!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Huh? Do I look nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: M—My apologies, I don't get out too often. I'm usually in the laboratory, where there aren't many others to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's okay, you don't have to force yourself! Paimon's sure that once we get to know each other better, we'll become really good friends!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}... Hey, aren't you the legendary Traveler? The one who repelled Stormterror?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I've heard so many stories about you! Always wanted an opportunity to research you up close!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, what do you mean "research"...?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah! Sorry, don't mind me. What am I saying...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, never mind. So, what were you two talking about just now?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Sucrose received a strange package recently...

choices.text: I don't even charge for autographs.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, there's a player nearby... That way! Let's go see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did it! Now we have two victories under our belt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get back to The Cat's Tail. Paimon wonders, who's Prince gonna pick as our final contestant?
